systematic_finding.name: Codillo de cerdo asado Hacendado
systematic_finding.reason: Tesseract had a 1-vs-1 carbohydrate split (30.0 vs 3.0) while EasyOCR and PaddleOCR independently agreed on the complete tuple 199 kcal / 13 g fat / 3 g carbohydrate / 17 g protein. The previous ensemble let the ambiguous Tesseract family veto two clean independent families.
systematic_finding.safety_fix: An ambiguous OCR family may now be ignored for a field only when at least two other unambiguous independent families agree within the existing tolerance. One clean family plus one ambiguous family remains REVIEW; cross-family disagreement remains REVIEW.
